Apply generously: Use enough to cover all exposed skin 15 minutes before sun exposure.
Reapply: After 80 minutes of swimming or sweating, immediately after towel drying, and at least every 2 hours.
Layering: Apply as the last step in your skincare routine before makeup.
Tips: Reviewer Simone suggests applying it all over your face and neck as a moisturizer and SPF, ensuring a healthy glow.
